coolicons
=========

This application bundles and displays icons from the "coolicons" icon set.

    Name      coolicons
    Author    Kryston Schwarze
    Source    https://github.com/krystonschwarze/coolicons
    Licence   Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
              https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution and commercial use, including shipping the
icons inside an application, provided attribution is given. That is what this
file and the credit in the application's About box are for.

The set is redistributed here in its original SVG form, recoloured at runtime
(the SVGs draw with stroke="currentColor", which QSvgRenderer does not
implement, so the colour is substituted before rendering). No icon artwork has
been altered otherwise.

Two glyphs shown in the application are NOT from coolicons: the pointer and the
scissors used by the clip editor's tool palette. The set contains neither, so
they were drawn for this project and live in supercut_extended/gui/icons.py.

The icon files themselves are not kept in this repository. See README.md for how
a checkout obtains them before a build.
